 Monday, Nov. 9 Daily Cable News Ratings: Fox News and MS NOW Battle It Out
 Primetime belonged to MS NOW and CNN programs
 By Mark Mwachiro 
 -->
 Highlight s – Monday, November 9, 2026 (Nielsen Big Data + Panel)
 It was a tight primetime race as Fox News beat MS NOW by an additional 33,000 total viewers. In the demo, MS NOW beat Fox News courtesy of 6,000 additional viewers.
 Fox News’ The Five was the most-watched program in total viewers and the Adults 25-54 demo.
 MS NOW’s The  Rachel Maddow  Show was the most-watched program in total viewers, and CNN’s Erin Burnett OutFront led the demo during primetime.
